name: checked
label: Checked
description: True if the checkbox is selected; otherwise false. If the `checked` status is neither true nor false, "indeterminate" causes the checkbox to appear with a horizontal line inside of it

name: manageChecked
label: Manage checked
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the checked property. Use the event dispatched when the field is clicked to handle the checked state manually

name: name
label: Identifier
description: Name of the checkbox. Dispatched along with the field value on user interaction

name: readonly
label: Read only
description: When true, the user cannot select the checkbox

name: label
label: Label
description: Text label to display next to the checkbox. You must provide either a label or an `aria-label` via the `ARIA properties`

name: required
label: Required
description: When true, the user must select the checkbox before they can submit the form

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: When true, the current state of the checkbox is invalid. An error displays and the visual style changes accordingly

name: manageInvalid
label: Manage invalid
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the invalid property. Use the invalid set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: labelPosition
label: Label position
description: Position at which to display the checkbox label relative to the checkbox

name: fullWidth
label: Full width
description: When true, the checkbox and label will be distributed across the x-axis accordingly
